title: Prove coefficient capacity prefixes and correct halved extension bound
body:
PR2796 understates the halved `children.extend` phase as ten index Words: the six parent indices and `f` coexist with four division temporaries, so it needs **eleven**. Independent literal capacities distinguish ten (rejection) from eleven (success); the complete child bound remains 22.

This source-bound audit also closes the coefficient portion of PR2831's capacity-prefix handoff. The credited adapter 37672/22 and child 20494/22 residue/index allowances bound each next allocation request before successful return is assumed. With canonical arenas and all entry residents counted, capacities `max(K,L+B)` exclude a first inventory failure. Semantic input/margin contracts remain; this does not admit the complete caller, physical reserve, supplier or a new kappa.

The new package is [`research/selected-coefficient-capacity-prefix`](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/tree/a06f5339a1ee22017f6099cb1dfc1c93c212c424/research/selected-coefficient-capacity-prefix), exact head `a06f5339a1ee22017f6099cb1dfc1c93c212c424`. Frozen PR2697 source and predecessor proof snapshots are unchanged and hash-pinned. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, Nick Petalas PR2759/2770/2778/2781, Arham Tahir PR2796, Ross Richardson PR2825/2831 and retained notices. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance includes a separate mathematical audit and independently built correction witness; no independent human or formal-kernel proof is claimed.

Validation: registered CPython3.12, current canonical-main runner, selected-record integrity and read-only Git-free optimized CPython3.14 all pass. Nine successful fixtures plus three actual quota failures observe 977159 pending allocations; eight defect controls include the false ten bound and retained-f mutation. Tests do not enumerate arbitrary programs/catalogue membership. Hosted CI remains separate.
